title: 第4章
content_zh: 第四章 护短的大将军(2)“爷爷，这事不怪她们，是我要觉醒的，你们先出去。”冷若雪撒娇地，拽着冷擎天的一只胳膊对两婢女道。“雪儿。”“爷爷，我灵力觉醒了，现在已经是大灵师了，爷爷不开心吗？”冷若雪柔声细语，有些撒骄地道。“傻丫头，爷爷当然开心，可是爷爷没在你身边，你自己觉醒要是有什么危险怎么办，到时爷爷就是想救都来不及，你想让爷爷担心死吗？”想到这，冷擎天的脸又板了起来。“爷爷，我的好爷爷，您这就叫关心则乱，我都知道觉醒是没有生命危险的，您这位灵皇怎么可能不知道呢！”冷若雪轻笑着道，觉醒成功是没有什么危险，不过失败了还是会使身体受到一些损伤的，这些在她打算觉醒前绿桃已经和她说过了，书上也提到过，所以她是知道的，可是她还是决定要觉醒，毕竟只有成为强者，命运才会掌握在自己的手中。“你这丫头……”冷擎天故意板着脸，不过明显已经没那么生气了。“来，你给爷爷说说啥时觉醒的，怎么成了大灵师了？”冷擎天也知道自己是有点紧张过度了。“昨天觉醒的。”冷若雪道。“今天就成大灵师了？”冷擎天满脸问号，这是什么速度啊！“嗯，昨天觉醒后，我就开始吸收灵力，今天醒来就已经是大灵师了。”冷若雪也没想到这身体的资质潜力居然如此的惊人，据她所知，灵力成功觉醒后，就算是资质最好的天才，想从最基础的修灵者进阶到修灵师也需要一年半到二年左右的时间，到大灵师则需要五到六年左右，资质差一些的需要的时间就更久了，像绿桃她们，资质中上，修到大灵师大约花了八年的时间。“想不到我冷擎天的宝贝孙女还是个妖孽级的天才，哈哈哈，好，真是太好了！”冷擎天刚毅严肃的脸上尽是得意的神色，最近这好消息真是接连不断啊，真是太开心了。“雪儿，你是什么属性的灵力？”他们冷家人基本都是风属性或火属性的灵力，像他就是风火双属性，所以在攻击上同阶的灵师一般都不是他的对手，否则他也不会被人称为灵皇巅峰第一强者。“我也不太清楚！”“没关系，爷爷那有测试水晶，有时间爷爷给你测试下。”除非对方使用灵技，否则是很难看出别人的属性的，而他猜想雪儿刚清醒，很多事都不是很了解，不知道自己属性也很正常，事实上，刚觉醒的灵师，可以去灵师公会测试属性，好修习适合自己的灵技，而一般的大家族都是有准备测试用的水晶的，这也是为了方便给家族中的后辈测试之用。“我的小雪儿现在清醒了，还成了灵师，又是个倾国倾城的小美人，我看这回七皇子李预还有什么理由不娶你。”冷擎天满脸慈爱地轻抚着冷若雪的头，话题转到了她的亲事上，其实在路上他就想好了，虽然他一点也不喜欢七皇子，更不想和皇家结姻亲，可是既然雪儿那么喜欢七皇子，那么那七皇子愿意得娶，不愿意也得娶，这事可由不得他，还想退婚？简直就是痴人做梦。“爷爷，我才不要嫁给七皇子。”冷若雪撅着粉嫩樱唇，美眸水汪汪地瞅着自己的爷爷。“呃…雪儿不是最喜欢七皇子的吗？怎么不愿意嫁了？”不想嫁了最好，皇家是非多着呢，不过他还是得问清楚点。“哼！我还是傻子的时候，他嫌弃我，还让人羞辱我，现在我好了，想明白了，所以我不要他了。”“对，不要他了，虽然他是皇子，可是他根本配不上咱们雪儿，明天爷爷就进宫给雪儿退婚去。”冷大将军极端护短，自家的孩子就算是毛病在多那也是自家的好，他管可以，别人想欺负，没门！“爷爷，婚是一定要退的，可是雪儿这次的伤也不能白受哦！”冷若雪小狐狸般地坏笑着提醒到。“放心，爷爷知道怎么做，爷爷不会让雪儿白受委屈地。”冷擎天可是不会放过任何一个，让自己的宝贝孙女受伤害的人的。“雪儿知道爷爷最疼雪儿了。”“爷爷，等我下哦！”冷若雪想了想，便跑了出去。不大一会的工夫，冷若雪手里端着一个瓷白色的大碗回来了。“雪儿，手里拿的什么？”“爷爷，快尝尝看！”冷若雪将手中的碗放在冷擎天的面前，一脸期待地看着。“面条？”“嗯，是雪儿亲手做的，爷爷快尝尝！”冷若雪对自己的厨艺可是非常有信心的，前世的她不但是个美食家，更有一手好厨艺，绝对赶得上那些名厨。“好，好，爷爷尝尝。”冷擎天用筷子挑了几根放到嘴里，愣了愣，又连吃了几大口一碗面就快见底了。“爷爷，怎么样？好吃吗？”冷若雪有些不确定，这个世界的调料实在太少了，食材也有些不同，做不出前世那个味道。“好吃，好吃。”冷擎天连碗里的汤都喝的干干净净，原本他吃的时候还在想，就算不好吃，他也会说好吃的，谁让这是雪儿的一片孝心呢！“雪儿什么时候学会做面条了？”冷擎天惊讶不已，还有些意犹未尽，他还从没吃过这么好吃的面呢！“以前看府里的厨子做过的，这几天自己试着做了下，雪儿记得前天是爷爷生日，就想着要做给爷爷吃。”冷若雪刚才就已经想好了说辞，而她这几天也确实自己动手做过，否则还真不好解释，主要是她感动于这个爷爷对她无条件的宠爱，前世求而不得的亲情，这一世却体会到了，所以她倍加珍惜。“雪儿真是孝顺，爷爷没白疼你！”冷擎天欣慰不已，自家的孩子就是好。
content_en: Chapter 4 The Protective General (2) "Grandpa, I don't blame them for this. I want to wake up. You go out first." Leng Ruoxue coquettishly pulled one of Leng Qingtian's arms and said to the two maids. "Xue'er." "Grandpa, my spiritual power has awakened, and I am now a great spiritual master. Isn't grandpa happy?" Leng Ruoxue whispered softly, a little arrogantly. "Silly girl, of course grandpa is happy, but grandpa is not with you. What if you wake up and are in danger? Grandpa will be too late to save you. Do you want grandpa to worry to death?" Thinking of this, Leng Qingtian's face became serious again. "Grandpa, my good grandpa, this is called caring and chaos. I know that awakening is not life-threatening. How could you, the Spiritual Emperor, not know!" Leng Ruoxue chuckled and said, there is no danger in awakening successfully, but failure will still cause some damage to the body. Lu Tao had already told her about this before she planned to awaken, and it was also mentioned in the book, so she knew it, but she still decided to awaken. After all, only by becoming strong will her destiny be in her own hands. "You girl..." Leng Qingtian deliberately kept a straight face, but he was obviously not that angry anymore. "Come on, tell me grandpa when you awakened and how you became a great spiritual master?" Leng Qingtian also knew that he was a little nervous. "I woke up yesterday." Leng Ruoxue said. "Become a great spiritual master today?" Leng Qingtian's face was full of questions, what kind of speed is this! "Well, after awakening yesterday, I started to absorb spiritual power. When I woke up today, I was already a great spiritual master." Leng Ruoxue did not expect that the body's aptitude potential was so amazing. As far as she knew, after the spiritual power was successfully awakened, even the genius with the best qualifications would be able to get the most out of it. It takes about one and a half to two years for a basic spiritual cultivator to advance to a spiritual cultivator, and about five to six years to reach a great spiritual master. Those with lower qualifications take even longer. Like Lu Tao and others, who have above-average qualifications, it took about eight years to become a great spiritual master. "I didn't expect that my precious granddaughter, Leng Qingtian, is still a monster-level genius. Hahaha, okay, that's great!" Leng Qingtian's resolute and serious face was full of pride. The good news has been coming one after another recently. I'm so happy. "Xue'er, what kind of spiritual power do you have?" The Leng family basically all have wind or fire attributes. For example, he has both wind and fire attributes. Therefore, spiritual masters of the same level are generally not his opponents in terms of attack. Otherwise, he would not be called the strongest at the peak of the Spiritual Emperor. "I'm not sure!" "It doesn't matter. Grandpa has a test crystal. Grandpa will test it for you when you have time." Unless the other party uses spiritual skills, it is difficult to see other people's attributes. And he guessed that Xueer had just woken up and didn't know many things very well. It was normal not to know his own attributes. In fact, newly awakened spiritual masters can go to the Spiritual Masters Guild to test their attributes so that they can learn spiritual skills that suit them. Generally, large families have crystals prepared for testing. This is also for the convenience of testing for the younger generations in the family. "My little Xue'er is awake now and has become a spiritual master. She is also a beautiful little girl who will conquer the country. I don't think the seventh prince Li Yu has any reason not to marry you this time." Leng Qingtian stroked Leng Ruoxue's head lovingly, and the topic turned to her marriage. In fact, he had thought about it on the way. Although he didn't like the seventh prince at all, and he didn't want to get married to the royal family, but since Xueer liked the seventh prince so much, then the seventh prince had to marry him if he wanted to, or if he didn't want to, it was not up to him, and he still wanted to break off the engagement? It's just a fool's dream. "Grandpa, I don't want to marry the seventh prince." Leng Ruoxue pursed her pink lips and looked at her grandfather with watery eyes. "Uh... doesn't Xue'er like the seventh prince the most? Why don't you want to marry?" It would be better if you don't want to marry. There are many disputes in the royal family, but he still has to ask clearly. "Hmph! When I was a fool, he disliked me and made others humiliate me. Now I'm better and have figured it out, so I don't want him anymore." "Yes, I don't want him anymore. Although he is a prince, he is not worthy of our Xue'er at all. Tomorrow, grandpa will go to the palace to break off Xue'er's engagement." General Leng is extremely protective of his shortcomings. Even if his own child has a problem, it is his own good. He can take care of it. Others want to bully him, no way! "Grandpa, the marriage must be called off, but Xue'er's injury this time cannot be in vain!" Leng Ruoxue reminded with a wicked smile like a little fox. "Don't worry, grandpa knows what to do. Grandpa will not let Xueer suffer in vain." Leng Qingtian will not let anyone go who will hurt his precious granddaughter. "Xue'er knows that grandpa loves Xue'er the most." "Grandpa, wait for me!" Leng Ruoxue thought for a while and ran out. After a while, Leng Ruoxue came back with a large porcelain white bowl in her hand. "Xue'er, what are you holding in your hand?" "Grandpa, try it quickly!" Leng Ruoxue placed the bowl in front of Leng Qingtian and looked at it expectantly. "Noodles?" "Well, it was made by Xue'er herself. Grandpa, please try it!" Leng Ruoxue was very confident in her cooking skills. In her previous life, she was not only a gourmet, but also had good cooking skills. She could definitely keep up with those famous chefs. "Okay, okay, grandpa, try it." Leng Qingtian picked a few noodles with chopsticks and put them in his mouth. He was stunned for a moment, and then he took a few big mouthfuls of noodles before the bowl of noodles was almost empty. "Grandpa, how is it? Is it delicious?" Leng Ruoxue is a little unsure. There are too few seasonings in this world, and the ingredients are also a little different, so it cannot taste like the previous life. "It's delicious, it's delicious." Leng Qingtian even drank the soup in the bowl cleanly. When he was eating, he was still thinking that even if it wasn't delicious, he would still say it was delicious. Who knew this was Xue'er's filial piety! "When did Xue'er learn to make noodles?" Leng Qingtian was surprised and still had some unfinished thoughts.
